title: Problem Set: Telecom CDR Packet Classifier & Billing Engine
solutionExplanation: Implements full multi-clause packet routing, empty payload guarding, and arity delegation for standard/premium/internal CDR billing.

otpDocCards.description: Multi-clause function definition with sequential pattern dispatch.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(1) compiled BEAM jump table for literal atom/integer tags.

mentalModelCheck.question: Why does bill_call(100, internal, 10) return {ok, 0} rather than calculating a connection fee?

options.label: Because the clause matching plan type "internal" specifies {ok, 0} regardless of duration or connection fee
options.explanation: The internal plan clause ignores duration and fees, returning {ok, 0} for free company communications.

options.label: Because Erlang integer division automatically rounds negative fees down to zero
options.explanation: No division is performed in bill_call; the clause directly returns the constant literal 0.

options.label: Because the connection fee is subtracted from the duration in a post-processing filter
options.explanation: There is no post-processing filter; clauses return their evaluated body directly.
